en.bilal-muhammad: He said: A man said to Abi Ja`far (as): O son of the Messenger of Allah! How will I know that the Night of Power occurs every year?
He said: When the month of Ramadan comes, recite Surat al-Dukhan once every night. Then, when the night of the twenty-third comes, you will await the confirmation of what you have asked about.
